title: Ad-hoc crosslink snapshot - one-off coverage & SLA stretch estimates
content:
Executive summary: Lightweight one-page spreadsheet to surface 1-off cross-team coverage gaps and estimated SLA stretch exposure for the upcoming feature push (Nov 14–21 window). Not a replacement for the formal runbook — used to prioritize quick mitigations and owner handoffs.

Rows (table):
ID,Item,Impact area,Owner,Severity (1-5),SLA stretch window,Estimated QPS effect,Estimated $/day delta,Immediate action,Status,Linked ticket,Comments
1,Region failover for gen-v2 routing,Serving / Smart routing,Samir Patel,4,Nov 14-16,peak +12%,$420,Enable soft-fallback to gen-v1 for low-priority routes,in_review,JIRA-OPS-912,Fallback will increase token cost but keeps p95 under target
2,Embeddings cache TTL mismatch,Optimize / Cache layer,Priya Rao,3,Nov 15-17,steady +4%,$120,Align TTL to 90s and clear stale keys,draft,JIRA-ENG-1873,Observed hit-rate drop after model swap; quick TTL fix low-risk
3,Console rollout telemetry noise,Console / Observability,Elena Torres,2,Nov 14-20,negligible,$0,Add a temporary filter in dashboards,done,N/A,Noise only; doesn't affect SLO but hides signal for on-call
4,Dedicated pool burst claim oversub,Capacity / Dedicated,Jordan Kim,5,Nov 14-21,burst +30%,$2,100,Throttle burst claims for new tenants + emergency reserve,in_review,JIRA-CAP-330,Risk: new partner onboarding scheduled same week
5,Private deployment kube image drift,Private-deployments,Alex Nguyen,4,Nov 13-18,intermittent +8%,$560,Pin runtime image tags and rollback older nodes,draft,JIRA-SEC-224,Requires infra support; may need one-off maintenance window
6,Billing spikes from test traffic,Billing / Quotas,Leah Park,3,Nov 16-17,short +20%,$950,Enable temporary per-tenant soft-limits and notify CS,planned,JIRA-BILL-778,Large internal tests scheduled; CS to reach out to test owner
7,QA harness pushing large KV warmups,Serving-runtime / KV cache,Omar Williams,2,Nov 15-16,transient +6%,$180,Rate-limit QA harness or run during low-traffic hours,draft,JIRA-TEST-409,Can be handled by queueing; low risk to prod
8,Model quantization edge-case,Applied-ML / Models,Rina Desai,4,Nov 14-19,moderate +9%,$700,Fallback to FP16 variant for affected routes,in_review,JIRA-ML-611,Quality regression risk; need eval on sample prompts

Assumptions and estimation notes:
- QPS effect numbers are conservative guesstimates based on recent traffic slices and similar past incidents.
- $/day delta uses blended unit-costs: hosted token cost + increased GPU-hour projection for Dedicated bursts.
- Severity scale: 5 = imminent customer-visible outage / SLO breach, 1 = cosmetic or internal-only noise.
- SLA stretch window intentionally includes buffer days to capture pre-rollout and cool-down traffic patterns.

Quick vetting checklist (one-off triage steps):
- Confirm owner contact and on-call during SLA window.
- Link to an existing runbook or create a short mitigation playbook in-line.
- If cost impact > $1k/day and severity >=4, escalate to product-ops lead and finance briefly.
- For Dedicated capacity items, ensure Ops approves any reserve/claims changes.

One-line mitigations log (for fast handoffs):
- Samir: enable gen-v1 fallback flag + monitor p95 (owner +1hr)
- Priya: patch cache TTL to 90s, purge stale prefix (owner +2hrs)
- Jordan: enact burst throttle policy, notify partners (ops-runbook attach)

Quick visual suggestions for a slide: 1) mini heatmap by severity vs cost (cells colored), 2) timeline bar showing SLA stretch windows, 3) owner swimlane showing immediate action state.

Next steps / owner asks: (1) each owner to add runbook link or paste mitigation steps by EOD Nov 8; (2) product-ops to confirm which items require an approved maintenance window by Nov 10; (3) CS to pause any large external tests overlapping Nov 16-17 or move to Nov 20+.

Decision log:
- 2029-11-06: snapshot created by Jordan Kim to coordinate cross-team triage.
- 2029-11-07: Console telemetry noise marked 'done' after filter applied (Elena).

Notes to reviewers: this is intentionally lightweight and contains rough dollar estimates for prioritization only. Please annotate with runbook links or adjust severity if you have recent telemetry contradicting the assumptions.
